verdict.rationale: RudderStack's own docs list each element of the story: Live Events for near-real-time source and destination event viewing, a Health Dashboard for pipeline metrics, Alerts for critical data issues, and MCP tooling to investigate destination delivery errors with root-cause analysis. The evidence is only one-line feature listings, so depth is unproven. Missing for 10: detailed docs on per-destination delivery/failure metrics, specifics of alert triggers and channels, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the debugger and dashboard.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can watch events flow live and diagnose delivery failures per destination — debugger views, delivery metrics, and alerting

citations.quote: Live Events View your source and destination events in near real-time
Health Dashboard Monitor your data pipelines and get key metrics at a glance
Alerts Get notified for critical data issues
Investigate destination delivery errors and get root cause analysis
Debug delivery errors, monitor pipelines, write and test transformations, review audit logs — all through natural language.
